limitations: Nine matched five-minute first periods per policy; not full-game win rates or a statistically established improvement.

All pairs have matching sources, lineups and initial-state hashes; all action hashes differ.

No attempt event reports goalie contact; general contact impulses and conceded goals increased. Changed trajectories also affect subsequent ordinary play.
One plan remained active at period end. All finalized plan events are preserved; aggregate counts include the unfinished plan.
Per-pass events and zone-entry event arrays are omitted; their aggregate outcomes, match metrics, full cross-crease events, sources, lineups and action hashes are retained.
